changelog: **Calendar export + print (#2005, 2/3):** `CalendarView` gets a "Download .ics" button that builds the file in the browser from the events on screen through the existing `buildFeedIcs()` (no second builder, no export route); UIDs match the subscription feed's (bare meeting id, `series-…`, `deadline-…`) so an imported copy and a subscribed one do not double, deadlines keep the feed's 30-minute marker and logged interactions stay out. `/api/calendar-events` now returns `durationMinutes` on meeting and series events (additive). A `@media print` block in `globals.css` prints the calendar on white with outlined events; the toolbar, view switcher, legend and the subscription card carry `.no-print`. Pinned by `e2e/calendar-export.spec.ts`.

en: Download the calendar range on screen as a .ics file for Google Calendar or Outlook, or print it as a clean sheet.
tr: Takvimde ekrandaki aralığı Google Takvim veya Outlook için .ics dosyası olarak indirin ya da sade bir sayfa olarak yazdırın.
de: Laden Sie den angezeigten Kalenderzeitraum als .ics-Datei für Google Kalender oder Outlook herunter oder drucken Sie ihn als aufgeräumtes Blatt.
